comments.story: Ask HN: Best dev tool pitches of all time?
comments.why: Revolutionary drag-and-drop Windows GUI building demo
comments.text: Another is Bill Gates Visual Basic 1.0 demo It was revolutionary. Before that, making a Windows GUI was pretty low level with calls to C APIs and callbacks and registrations. Visual Basic changed all that with point and drag and drop and you could make a GUI in a matter of minutes. [VIDEO]
